name: entry
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: MSVC CRT entry: parses the command line, calls WinMain

name: WinMain
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Single-instance check (FindWindow), error log c:\error.txt, init, PeekMessage loop calling Input_Poll + Game_Frame when idle

name: WndProc
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Window procedure (QueryCancelAutoPlay, activation)

name: Game_Frame
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Per-frame dispatch on Game_GetMode: 0 front end, 2 world/loading, 3 race

name: Game_GetMode
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Returns the top-level mode (0 front end, 2 loading, 3 race)

name: Proc_InitSlot
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Initialises one process slot (state, event)

name: Proc_Init
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Process group: count, slots, state table {update, draw}, transition table

name: Proc_UpdateAll
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Calls each slot's state update function

name: Proc_DrawAll
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Calls each slot's state draw function (skipped once after a switch)

name: Proc_Advance
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Applies pending state transitions (bits 24-25 flag, bits 16-23 next state), else counts frames in state

name: AtExit_Register
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Registers a shutdown callback

name: World_Frame
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Mode 2 process group (state table 0x526ee0)

name: Race_Frame
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Mode 3: builds one process per player (state table 0x5190b0) then runs them

name: Timer_Sample
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Latches timeGetTime() for the frame

name: Timer_Now
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Latched timeGetTime()

name: Timer_Centis
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Monotonic game clock in 1/100 s

name: File_Load
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: gzopen (zlib, transparent for raw files); if CMPR header read the payload, else plain ReadFile; CD retry dialog

description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Bfl_LoadInto + sets the slot's loaded flag

name: Bfl_Find
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Linear search of the trailing directory by lower-cased name; returns member pointer, size via out param

name: Path_Basename
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Copies the part after the last / or \\

name: Bfl_FindFile
description (docs/re/architecture.md, do: Bfl_Find on the basename of a path

name: Bfl_FindTexture

name: Text_ToFontCase

name: Registry_Language
